subject.title: feat: Add local Codex Workspaces analytics

question: Should a missing dedicated Workspaces preference inherit the existing local cost-usage setting, with an explicitly set Workspaces preference taking precedence?
rationale: This changes the default behavior seen by existing users and cannot be selected safely from implementation evidence alone.

options.title: Approve inheritance default
options.body: Keep Workspaces aligned with existing local cost-usage enablement until a user explicitly chooses a dedicated Workspaces setting.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Make Workspaces disabled until users enable its own preference, avoiding inherited activation after upgrade.

options.title: Defer the UI surface
options.body: Land only the foundation now and revisit the preference contract with a narrower product proposal.

recommendation.title: Approve inheritance default
recommendation.body: Keep Workspaces aligned with existing local cost-usage enablement until a user explicitly chooses a dedicated Workspaces setting.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR explicitly requests maintainer acceptance of this user-facing default and staged boundary.
